note: RFC 7313 Section 4 requires a speaker that received the Graceful Restart Capability from its neighbor to ignore any BoRR for an <AFI, SAFI> before receiving the EoR for that <AFI, SAFI>. Session.processValidatedMessage (internal/component/bgp/reactor/session_read.go:618-643, also reached by session_coalesce.go) records per-family received EoR in Session.recordReceivedEOR and gates BoRR via Session.routeRefreshBoRRBeforeEOR (selected_refresh_eor.go:48-95) on PeerAdvertised(CodeGracefulRestart) and PeerAdvertised(CodeEnhancedRouteRefresh) before plugin delivery, logging codeDoctorBGPBoRRBeforeEOR. TestRFC7313RxBoRRIgnoredBeforeEoRFromGRPeer (rfc7313_gr_eor_gate_test.go) feeds real wire frames through Session.ReadAndProcess: positive proves IPv4 BoRR is ignored before IPv4 EoR even after IPv6 EoR (per-<AFI, SAFI> scoping), sends no NOTIFICATION, and keeps the session Established (without requiring local GR); negative proves IPv4 BoRR is delivered once IPv4 EoR arrives and is delivered immediately before EoR from a non-GR peer.
